You may have seen the recent Clone Wars / Dark Horse Comics news, and I thought I would chime in and clarify things a bit...}}}} '''''Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir''''' is a four-issue [[canon]] and [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], and illustrated by penciller [[Juan Frigeri]], inker [[Mauro Vargas]], colorist [[Wes Dzioba]], and cover artist [[Chris Scalf]]. The miniseries was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] beginning on [[May 21]], [[2014]], and concluded with the [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|fourth]] and final issue on [[August 20]], 2014. A [[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir (trade paperback)|''Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' trade paperback]] was released on [[October 1]], 2014 and re-published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[November 21]], [[2017]]. ''Son of Dathomir'' is an adaptation of unproduced scripts from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which was part of the television show's sixth production season. The episodes that ''Son of Dathomir'' were based on were not completed and therefore not released as actual episodes. The story is part of ''[[The Clone Wars Legacy]]'' line. The series is set during the [[Clone Wars]], and is a continuation of [[Maul|Darth Maul's]] story from the show. The rogue [[Sith Lord]], who was revealed to have survived the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] in the ''Clone Wars'' episode "[[Witches of the Mist]]," has been captured by his former [[Sith Master|master]], [[Darth Sidious]], following the events of another ''Clone Wars'' episode titled "[[The Lawless]]." Sidious uses Maul in an attempt to draw [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]], Maul's mother and the leader of the [[Nightsisters]], out of hiding so she can be destroyed, as Sidious considers her a potential threat to the eventual [[Sith]] domination of [[the galaxy]]. Maul confronts the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and captures [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and [[General]] [[Grievous]] in pursuit of vengeance against his old master, while the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order]] become involved in the hopes that they can defeat Maul, Dooku, and Grievous—and, in doing so, end the war.
